ecosystemProperties.title: Convomargin

deepContext.h2: Auditing Variable API Spend for AI Apps
deepContext.body: Building on OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models introduces unpredictable token usage. Convomargin audits prompt structures and calculates gross margins per user session.
